title: Trisyllabical
summary: TRISYLLAB'ICAL, a. [from trisyllable.] Pertaining to a trisyllable; consisting of three syllables; as a trisyllabic word or root.

inlines.v: TRISYLLAB'ICAL, a. [from trisyllable.] Pertaining to a trisyllable; consisting of three syllables; as a trisyllabic word or root.
